in_marathi.name: Kyansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mountain of joy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kyansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'khyana' meaning 'mountain' and 'ansh' meaning 'joy'. This name represents a joyful mountain, signifying strength, stability, and happiness.

in_bengali.name: Kyansh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Mountain of joy
